name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
summary: Collateral-free credit for micro and small enterprises by guaranteeing the lender against default. You do not apply directly: your bank applies on your behalf once it has appraised the loan.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
implementing_agency: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
benefit_description: Guarantee cover on credit facilities up to Rs 10 crore per borrower, with coverage of 75% to 90% of the amount in default depending on borrower category and region.

criteria.description: The enterprise must be a micro or small enterprise as defined by the Ministry of MSME. Medium enterprises are not covered.
criteria.source_quote: Loans sanctioned to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSE) units, as per the definition of the Ministry of MSMEs.

criteria.description: The enterprise should hold Udyam registration, which lenders require to confirm micro or small classification.
The lending institution must judge the proposal commercially viable on its own merits. The guarantee removes the collateral requirement; it does not remove the need for a bankable proposal.
criteria.source_quote: CGTMSE extends them helping hand by providing guarantee to enable them access credit leading to setting up viable micro and small enterprises.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Self-declare on the Udyam portal using PAN and Aadhaar. Issued almost immediately, and validated against your PAN and GSTIN records.

document_requirements.document_name: Project report or business plan with financial projections
document_requirements.issuing_authority_name: Prepared by the applicant, often with a chartered accountant
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Prepared in-house or by a CA. Banks reject weak projections more often than they reject weak businesses, so the assumptions behind the numbers matter.

document_requirements.document_name: Bank statements for the preceding 6 to 12 months
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Download from net banking or request at your branch.

windows.notes: No application window. The guarantee is sought by the lender at the time it sanctions your credit facility, so your timeline is your bank's timeline.

benefits.description: Guarantee cover to the lender, which is what allows the facility to be extended without collateral or third-party guarantee. The guarantee ceiling was raised from Rs 5 crore to Rs 10 crore per borrower with effect from 1 April 2025.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Coverage of 75% to 90% of the amount in default, varying by borrower category and geography. An annual guarantee fee is payable, typically passed through to the borrower.
benefits.source_quote: The guarantee ceiling for the loan extended under CGS was enhanced from Rs. 5 crore to Rs. 10 crore w.e.f 01.04.2025.
